sources.name: SMS Spam Collection
sources.notes: 5,574 real SMS messages with spam/ham labels. Sparrow target labels are generated independently by the dual-pass teacher; spam/ham is not equivalent to a Sparrow Safety reason. Preserve dataset attribution.

sources.name: ScamShield Scam Detection Dataset
sources.license: MIT wrapper; upstream source attribution still required
sources.notes: Contains SMS Spam Collection plus EMSCAD and a small synthetic contrastive portion. Do not blindly combine its SMS rows with UCI; exact deduplication is mandatory and upstream licenses/attribution must be retained.

sources.name: Tanaos Synthetic Spam Detection Dataset German
sources.notes: Synthetic spam/not-spam data. Do not use as Sparrow's gold validation/test benchmark and do not map spam/not_spam directly to Sparrow labels; run the same automatic Sparrow teacher labeling.

sources.name: SMS Dataset OTP / OTP Intent / Phishing
sources.license: MIT; gated access conditions also apply
sources.notes: Requires accepting Hugging Face dataset access conditions. OTP presence is not the same as CREDENTIAL_REQUEST; run the same automatic Sparrow teacher labeling.

sources.name: ScamGuardBench
sources.notes: Useful especially for false-positive testing on legitimate-but-confusable messages. It is not automatically imported because its taxonomy differs from Sparrow's four semantic reasons.

sources.name: EmbeddingGemma 300M
sources.license: Gemma terms apply to the model; MediaPipe runtime/API licensing is separate
sources.notes: Exact int4/int8 MediaPipe task model used by Sparrow's Android LocalEmbeddingModel. The URL contains 'latest'; record and pin the downloaded SHA-256 for reproducibility.
